text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Oguri Cap has managed to leave quite a mark on the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Together, we've successfully navigated the crucial first three years of her career.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, while still basking in the glory of our accomplishments…

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Bear with me for just a little longer. I'm almost done!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Oguri Cap invited me to meet her down by the river where we often train together.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I followed the recipe from back home as closely as I could, so I'm sure it'll taste delicious!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It turns out she's making stewed meat.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I wanted to show you how much I appreciate you.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Training with you has helped me grow into a better racer.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Everyone in my hometown is really pleased with my progress too. It's like a dream come true for me.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Thank you for running by my side all this time.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Let's keep racing toward our goals together.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: These five bowls aren't gonna eat themselves!
